scope_note: Every row of the input window a derived value was computed from, saved when the run captured it. A run written before this artifact existed has none and is NOT backfilled: its derived values keep their method, version and window parameters only.

units.Open: USD (split/dividend adjusted when auto_adjust is true)
units.High: USD (split/dividend adjusted when auto_adjust is true)
units.Low: USD (split/dividend adjusted when auto_adjust is true)
units.Close: USD (split/dividend adjusted when auto_adjust is true)

close_50_sma.definition: simple moving average of Close, window=50

close_200_sma.definition: simple moving average of Close, window=200

boll.definition: simple moving average of Close, window=20

boll_ub.definition: boll + 2 x sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of Close over 20 periods

boll_lb.definition: boll - 2 x sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of Close over 20 periods

macd.definition: EMA(Close, span=12, adjust=False) - EMA(Close, span=26, adjust=False)

provider_call.window: 5 years back from the fetch day to the day after it (end exclusive)

processing.cache: per-symbol CSV in data_cache_dir keyed by the window dates; a non-empty cached file is reused, so the provider fetch day can be earlier than the run
cleaning: parse Date; drop rows whose Date cannot be parsed
coerce Open/High/Low/Close/Volume to numbers (unparseable values become missing)
drop rows with a missing Close
forward-fill, then back-fill, the remaining gaps in Open/High/Low/Close/Volume
processing.cutoff: rows with Date <= the requested analysis date, sorted ascending by Date (re-applied by the verified snapshot)
processing.stale_check: the latest row must be within 10 calendar days of the requested date
